hits.text: //! SyncEngine trait. Backends conform to this trait to provide replication.
//! The Rust backends are NoSyncEngine (passthrough) and FederationSyncEngine
//! (Ed25519-authenticated peer-to-peer).
//! The trait is synchronous, as PersistenceKit's Rust trait is.
//! `subscribe` returns a std::sync::mpsc::Receiver<SyncEvent>.
//! FederationSyncEngine: Ed25519-authenticated peer-to-peer
//! backend.
//! Transport is pluggable behind the `Relay` trait. `FederationRelay`
//! is the in-process implementation used for local peering and tests.
//! All envelopes are signed at push and verified at pull. Schema
//! and kit mismatch reject the record. Conflict resolution
//! follows the per-table ConflictPolicy on the local manifest.
//! A refused inbound record writes one log line naming its table and key,
//! with no values. The lines are also kept on the
//! pulling thread so the test can read them.
//! convergence-kit
//! Sync abstraction layer: core types, wire format, SyncEngine trait, and
//! two backends: None (passthrough) and Federation (Ed25519 peer-to-peer).
//! CloudKit is Apple-only and is not implemented in this crate.
//! NoSyncEngine: passthrough backend. enable returns AlreadyEnabled
//! on repeat calls; push/pull return NotEnabled before enable, then
//! empty receipts; subscribe returns a receiver whose sender is
//! dropped immediately rather than a long-lived never-emitting receiver.
//! Used when sync is structurally not wanted (development,
//! tests, deployments without iCloud or federation).
//! Optional owning-domain authorization of cached outbound rows.
//! Federation pairing value types (paper section 9.2). Two estates
//! share a hyperplane family so their 256-bit fingerprints are directly
//! comparable across the federation.
//! This module defines the Codable proposal/acceptance types and a
//! canonical byte helper. It does not implement negotiation, signing,
//! or verification; those are caller responsibilities.
//! SyncRecord wire format.
//! SyncRecord wraps a PersistenceKit TableChange with sync metadata
//! (schema version, kit id, HLC). The receiver decodes, validates
//! schema and kit, and applies the change through its local
//! PersistenceKit. Schema or kit mismatch is counted as a conflict
//! and the record is skipped; no retry queue is present.
//! Core ConvergenceKit types.
//! Golden JSON vector tests for the cross-port wire contract. Assertions
//! check decoded fields and substrings, not whole encoded strings.
//! The observe-time verdict on a local change under an outbound authorizer:
//! a denial retracts an update (delete for every peer) or withholds an
//! insert; an authorizer ERROR withholds and is reported, never retracted.
